SELECT * FROM product WHERE name = #{name} AND is_available = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM product WHERE category = #{category} AND is_available = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_available = 1 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.base_price, p.image_url, p.is_available, p.is_deleted, sp.store_price, sp.stock_quantity FROM product p INNER JOIN store_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.id WHERE sp.store_id = #{storeId} AND sp.is_available = 1 AND sp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_available = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.category_id, p.id
